Kelly Hudson Properties proudly present this 2 bedroom ground floor apartment to the market for sale. 

This well-presented two-bedroom ground floor apartment is ideally situated in the popular Ardevan Court development in Monasterevin. Offering bright, comfortable and well-proportioned accommodation, the property is an excellent choice for first-time buyers, downsizers, investors or those looking for a convenient home in a peaceful setting.

The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a spacious living room, a well-appointed kitchen, two comfortable bedrooms and a main bathroom. The apartment benefits from ground floor living and enjoys a pleasant outlook over the development's large communal green area, providing an attractive open aspect and a sense of space.

Ardevan Court is a well-established residential development, conveniently located close to Monasterevin town centre and its range of shops, cafés, schools and local amenities. The property also benefits from excellent transport links, with easy access to the M7 motorway and Monasterevin railway station, making it an ideal location for commuters. An excellent opportunity to acquire a comfortable two-bedroom apartment in a convenient and attractive residential development. 

Viewing comes highly recommended strictly by prior appointment with Agent only.

Bedroom 1: Wooden flooring, fully fitted wardrobe
